note: News desk. Every day the channel posts ONE trending global AI story, explained simply in Uzbek. The four story types below are the whole menu; the day only sets a lean so the week does not become one type.

Big Tech.what: A deal, launch, model, acquisition or strategy move by a name everyone knows (Apple, Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, Nvidia, Microsoft, Meta, xAI, Tesla, DeepSeek, Alibaba).
Big Tech.example: Apple rasman Google bilan hamkorlik qilishini e’lon qildi: Siri uchun Gemini, taxminan $1 mlrd.

AI startap.what: A startup most readers have not heard of, with a big number (round, valuation, revenue, users), a product you can explain in two sentences, and famous customers or investors.
AI startap.example: $500 million baholangan Listen Labs qanday qilib Microsoft va Sweetgreen bilan ishlayapti?

Founder story.what: How founders went from a small start to a big number, told as a timeline with the numbers at each step.
Founder story.example: Oddiy GPUlardan $120 millionlik AI biznesgacha: Runpod.

AI hayotda.what: A country, school, hospital, factory, city or profession using AI in a way the reader can picture, best with a video or photo.
AI hayotda.example: Xitoy maktablarida uy vazifalarini sun’iy intellekt tekshirmoqda.

academy.what: AI skills for students and engineers: explainers, tools, prompts, how-tos. Never imply AIS Academy has a running course.

studio.what: Founders and venture building: founder lessons, behind the scenes, startup stories from Uzbekistan.

corporate.what: AI adoption in companies: use cases, myths vs facts, what managers should do.

ventures.what: Funding and the ecosystem: rounds, investors, how to raise, AIS Ventures' thesis.

news.what: The AI story the world is talking about, explained simply in Uzbek.

Mon.brief: Today's lean is Big Tech: when two stories are equally strong, rank the one of this type first. A clearly bigger story of another type still goes first. Monday also catches the biggest story of the weekend.

Tue.brief: Today's lean is AI startap: when two stories are equally strong, rank the one of this type first. A clearly bigger story of another type still goes first.

Wed.brief: Today's lean is Founder story: when two stories are equally strong, rank the one of this type first. A clearly bigger story of another type still goes first.

Thu.brief: Today's lean is AI hayotda: when two stories are equally strong, rank the one of this type first. A clearly bigger story of another type still goes first.

Fri.brief: Today's lean is Big Tech: when two stories are equally strong, rank the one of this type first. A clearly bigger story of another type still goes first.

Sat.brief: Today's lean is AI hayotda: when two stories are equally strong, rank the one of this type first. A clearly bigger story of another type still goes first.

Sun.brief: Optional: only if a trending AI story scores >= 0.6 or the leads sent an idea.

always: An idea sent by a lead goes first.
The story must be trending now: several big outlets in the last 48 hours (72 for founder and real-life stories), or the top of Techmeme or Hacker News.
At most 2 of the 10 ideas are local: one local AI story that passes the same tests, one AI opportunity whose deadline is within 7 days. They go last unless a lead sent them.
Never the same story type first two days in a row unless the story is clearly the biggest of the day.
